sequence.title: The Domain
sequence.objective: Unlimited Void as the supernatural climax - mechanism shown, not a magic button; the touch exemption nearly saves Thragg; Gojo's gamble begins.
sequence.logic: Thragg's last leverage is the lit city (T1-19). He climbs into Purple's dust plume to deny Gojo the body-read he has relied on since Seq 3 (S6-01). The Six Eyes still find the civilian-level haze (R1): it tells Gojo WHERE Thragg is, never what he intends (R5). It coils, then snaps down and west (S6-02). The geometry gives the WHY: extended, Thragg's line runs straight down the avenue at the lights (S6-03). Seq 5 taught Gojo that anything he aims, this body can dodge; a chase loses; Purple needs time. The one thing Thragg cannot dodge is a sure-hit. So Gojo spends his single teleport (R11) to stand in the path at the west corner (S6-03 to S6-04). Thragg, true to his Seq 2-4 lessons, does not run into the stall or stop in reach: he brakes dead on the air 8 m out to re-read a man who appeared from nowhere. The plant costs him a second, because the torn ear makes his flight wobble (S6-04). In that second Gojo forms the one-hand sign in total silence and makes the call (S6-05). Thragg's Seq 5 lesson ('when he needs time, strike') makes him lunge, and the barrier closes on the first frame of the lunge, so its momentum dies with his mind (S6-05/06). The barrier registers his faint haze (R1), so the sure-hit lands. Inside, about 2.0 s of real time plays as about 20 s of perception time (logged deviation; G2-16); it is never slow motion. His flight dies with his mind and he sinks (S6-07), and his perception drowns (S6-08). One Blue pins and turns him, opening the Purple-flayed flank (S6-09). Gojo knows touch exempts (G1-32), so his three positioning touches last one frame each (one-frame pupil strobes), but a heart thrust cannot. For its duration the flood pauses, though what has arrived stays (R8): clouded, Thragg acts on reflex and will, and his body corkscrews the heart off the line: ribs and the left lung go, the heart does not (S6-10, T1-34). His grab stalls in Infinity; Gojo pulls out, and the flood slams back (S6-11). Gojo cannot read Thragg's vitals, and every touch inside wakes him, while 2 s of flood (ten times Shibuya's dose, double Shoko's Sukuna figure) should leave him frozen afterwards. So he decides to finish by hand outside and withdraws to his corner (S6-12). The exterior cutaway runs on the objective clock: everything inside was a silent black dome for exactly 2.0 s, which makes the pre-set visible (S6-13). The void peels away with both men still hanging in the air; on the last frame it collapses and the Blue pin winks out with it, so burnout begins on the cut and both fall from Seq 7's first frame (S6-14, R9). Gojo's lesson, that a precise blow can be slipped, is why Seq 7's finish is a Red inside the chest and not a hand for the heart. Screen direction: Gojo is screen-left and Thragg screen-right in every shot. Reverse-angle cameras face north-east or north-west, never south. Slow motion is never used.
sequence.music_cue: Seq 5's aftermath strings thin to one high line, with a tempo-less sub pulse under the climb (S6-01, S6-02). Thragg's descending minor-third motif SWELLS in fast low brass on the break (S6-03 f4) and peaks on the teleport. SILENCE (score and ambience) falls at S6-04 f20 as the hand rises; the call is delivered over total silence (S6-05). domain_open's snap (S6-06 f0) is followed by 7 frames of absolute zero, then high crystalline clusters SWELL over a sub drone and the granular information-tick bed (S6-06 f8). There is no rhythm anywhere inside the domain; a heartbeat sits under Thragg's close-ups (S6-07, S6-08, S6-10, S6-12). The bed is the flood made audible: each one-frame touch hiccups it, it DROPS OUT for the spear-hand's contact while Thragg is exempt (S6-10 f23), and it RETURNS at full on the frame contact ends (S6-11 f28). The exterior is a hard cut to SILENCE, wind only (S6-13 f0). Back inside, the clusters bend downward into the reversed shatter (domain_close) and DROP OUT on S6-14 f84, so Seq 7 opens on isolated piano-like tones over the dust.
sequence.state_out: Gojo: at the west corner, ~3 m up, x=-7, y=3 (about to drop); facing east; eyes narrow; injuries jacket_torn_shoulder, bloodshot_eyes; condition: domain ending -> burnout (drained, breathing hard; right hand bloody to the wrist with Thragg's blood; decided to finish by hand). Thragg: mid-lunge ~8 m east of Gojo, x=+1, y=2 (about to drop), the Blue pin winked out on the last frame (S6-14 f85), so nothing holds him; facing west; cape torn; injuries mouth_blood, torn_suit, cracked_ribs, chest_burn, forearm_lost, flank_flayed, ear_torn, lung_ruptured, nosebleed, ear_blood, eye_blood (plus two broken left ribs and unequal pupils, not tagged); right hand frozen reaching. Env: no new damage from the domain itself (flags unchanged: landing_crater, mast_sheared, east_smash, tower_gutted, clouds_torn, purple_scar, smoke); Purple's dust plume torn open by the break; the mast pole (arm sheared) still standing.

shots.action: Real time. f0-18: the pause after Purple. Both hover 90 m apart over the smoking district. Thragg breathes heavily; the cauterised stump of his left forearm hangs; blood ribbons from his flayed flank and torn ear in the wind. His flight lists and he trims it. His head turns a few degrees, past Gojo to the lit city glowing on the far-left horizon, then back to Gojo. f18-23: one compressed anticipation: shoulders drop, chin tucks. f24-60: he rises up and backs away east, still facing Gojo, into the belly of the brown-grey Purple dust plume drifting west over the channel. The torn ear makes him list twice and correct. f52-62: the plume's underside swallows his silhouette; the shredded cape is the last thing to vanish. f62-72: hold on the churning plume. Gojo, tiny on screen-left, has not moved; only his head has tracked.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg looks past Gojo at the lit city, then backs up into Purple's dust plume and vanishes.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme wide shot high above a ruined city at storm-dark dusk. Screen-left, a tiny tall figure with white hair and a black high-collared uniform hovers in open air. Screen-right and lower, a massive one-armed man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit hovers listing to one side: the cauterised stump of his left forearm hangs, a raw flayed wound runs down his left flank, and shredded crimson cape remnants trail from one shoulder. Below them, a clean-edged channel cuts through four dark towers, faint violet afterglow on the cut edges, smoke columns rising. A towering brown-grey dust plume drifts across the channel; the big man rises backwards into its belly and disappears. Far left, across a river, a lit city glows under a smouldering sunset; light shafts fall through torn clouds.

tactical.intent: Thragg: put dust between himself and Gojo to deny the body-read Gojo has used since Seq 3, and set up a break Gojo cannot predict.
tactical.read: Gojo: this is cover, the way Toji used it against him. The Six Eyes will still see the faint haze, so he waits for it to commit rather than fire blind at a body that dodged Purple.
tactical.outcome: Thragg vanishes from sight. Gojo holds his position and his output.
tactical.learned: Thragg: Gojo will not fire blindly into cover. The first move is his.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 2s for the hover, on 1s for the climb. The list is a slow 8-degree roll with two corrective trims (torn ear: flavour only, per R12). Blood ribbons stream east (wind from the west). Gojo is a near-held cel with a slow head track; his loose hair stirs in the altitude wind. The plume is a volumetric mass with parallax, drifting west across frame. Continuity in: Gojo's eyes open and still bloodshot after Seq 5's RCT refresh.

shots.action: Real time. f0-14: MCU. Gojo hovers, breathing deliberately, eyes open and bloodshot; the plume churns behind him. f14-22: his eyes narrow; whatever was left of the clowning is gone. f20-36: push in to the near eye. f36-44: across the blue iris plays what the Six Eyes see in the plume, in Seq 1's grammar: a deep-navy field of faint flowing contour lines. Low in the dust the lines crowd and bend around a dense, man-shaped mass, wrapped in a faint, flickering, civilian-level haze. It tells him WHERE, not what Thragg intends (R5). The haze tightens into a coil, the only anticipation the dust lets him see. f44-46: the haze snaps down and west, a bright streak across the iris. f46-52: the pupil flicks down-left after it.
shots.animatic_caption: The Six Eyes can't see through the dust, only a faint haze. It coils, then snaps down and west.
shots.prompt_core: Medium close-up pushing into an extreme close-up of a white-haired man hovering in a dusk sky, three-quarter view facing right: hair loose over his forehead, a black blindfold hanging around his neck, a high-collared black uniform torn and bloodstained at the left shoulder. His vivid blue eyes, faintly bloodshot, narrow in total concentration. Behind him, softly out of focus, a towering brown-grey dust plume churns. In the extreme close-up the crystalline blue iris fills the frame, and across its surface plays a dark navy field of faint flowing contour lines. The lines bunch around a dense, hidden man-shaped mass wrapped in a thin flickering haze. The haze coils, then streaks down and to the left, and the pupil flicks to follow.

tactical.intent: Gojo: find Thragg without the body-read.
tactical.read: The haze coils low in the plume, so he is loading a break, but its direction cannot be read until it fires (R5).
tactical.outcome: Gojo sees the break the instant it starts: down and west.
tactical.learned: Gojo: he is not coming at me. He is going past me.

shots.animation_notes: Gojo on 2s; the narrowing is a 6-frame ease, and his eyes switch to 'narrow' from f22 for the rest of the sequence. The push-in eases in and out. The Six Eyes field in the iris uses S1-06's grammar exactly (navy field, contour lines bending around a dense mass, thin flickering haze), so the audience reads it as the same sense. Keep the iris overlay low-contrast; the f44 streak is its only bright mark.

shots.action: Real time. f0-3: the plume's underside bulges. f4: Thragg bursts out of it in a white vapour cone with a boom ring, tearing the dust open behind him. f4-30: he dives down and left in one hard curve, levelling off just above the street at the east edge of the intersection. The last intact windows along the east block burst outward in sequence beneath his path. The geometry is the whole read: from up here his line, extended, runs straight down the avenue, across the river, into the lit city on the far-left horizon. f8-22: Gojo's head (foreground) turns down-left, tracking. f22-26: a half-beat: his head lifts a few degrees toward the lit city, then comes back. The split-second decision. f26-30: space folds in around him and his silhouette compresses toward a point. f30: he is gone, leaving a faint implosion ring and a puff of displaced air. f30-40: empty air in the foreground; far below, the streak races low into the intersection toward the west corner.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg breaks low and west, straight at the lit city. Gojo reads the line and vanishes.
shots.prompt_core: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot from behind a white-haired man hovering 200 metres above a ruined city at dusk, his shoulder and hair a dark silhouette in the lower-left foreground. Below lie a dark evacuated district, a wide intersection, smoke columns and a clean channel cut through eastern towers. A white-and-crimson streak bursts from the underside of a huge dust plume on the right in a vapour cone and boom ring, then dives in a hard curve toward the street as windows burst outward in sequence along its path. The streak levels off low and points straight along the avenue at a river and a brightly lit city glowing under a sunset on the far-left horizon. Space folds inward around the hovering man and he vanishes in a faint implosion ring.

tactical.intent: Thragg: go for the lights at full speed. Gojo must choose between the people and holding back, and there is no time for another Purple.
tactical.read: Gojo: the haze told him where, and the line tells him why: the lights. Anything he aims, this body can dodge (Seq 5). A chase loses, and Purple needs charge time. Only a sure-hit cannot be dodged.
tactical.outcome: Gojo teleports to the west corner, into Thragg's path.
tactical.learned: Gojo: he will use the city every time. End it now, with the one thing he cannot dodge.

No flash and no glow trail: teleport is space compressed by Limitless (G1-43). This is R11's single use.

shots.action: Real time. f0: space unfolds at the west corner and Gojo is simply there, hovering 3 m up beside the sheared mast pole, his old perch, facing east, directly in the line. A faint outward ring of displaced air marks the arrival. f1-3: Thragg's streak enters frame-right, low over the crater. f3: he sees Gojo where Gojo cannot be. f3-8: a hard plant on the air. His body rotates upright first, then the trajectory dies: a vapour cone collapses forward off him and a fan of grit is blasted off the street below. He stops dead 8 m from Gojo, out of reach. f5-10: the braking shock rolls on ahead of him and stalls in the space around Gojo. Grit and chips thrown at dangerous speed hang a hand's width short of him, jittering, while the shock's side lobes flow around and lift the dust of the corner behind him. Gojo's collar and hair do not stir. f8-20: the plant costs Thragg. His torn ear makes his flight wobble and list, and he trims once, twice. f18-32: Gojo's right hand begins to rise. f20: THE WORLD GOES SILENT: wind, debris and music are all gone. The picture keeps moving; the sound does not.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo teleports into the path. Thragg brakes on the air 8 m out. The world goes silent.
shots.prompt_core: Low wide shot from street level in a ruined dusk intersection. On the left, beside a bent traffic-light pole whose arm has been sheared off, a tall white-haired man in a high-collared black uniform hovers three metres above the asphalt, facing right, a faint ring of displaced air around him as if he has just appeared. From the right, a massive one-armed man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit brakes violently in mid-air low over a crater, body upright, a white vapour cone collapsing forward off him and a fan of grit blasted off the street below. Grit and chips hang motionless a hand's width short of the hovering man; there is no glow and no barrier. Shredded crimson cape remnants whip forward. Light shafts fall through torn clouds; a lit city glows far left.

tactical.intent: Thragg: never run into the stall and never stop in reach (Seq 2-4). Brake dead, out of reach, and re-read a man who just appeared from nowhere.
tactical.read: Gojo: he stopped. He reads before he commits, and he is wobbling.
tactical.outcome: Thragg halts 8 m out, and his torn ear costs him about a second to re-trim. The shock's grit hangs short of Gojo.
tactical.learned: Thragg: the man can be anywhere instantly. The run for the lights is dead.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 1s: the plant follows the VFX bible's 'hard plant' (rotation leads, trajectory follows). Gojo is a held cel f0-18 apart from the arrival ring; the hand rise is on 2s from f18. The hanging grit uses S2-02's Zeno grammar (hang, jitter, no drift toward him). From f20 only the sound stops; dust, smoke and Thragg's trim keep moving.

shots.action: Real time, in total silence: no wind, no score. f0-6: Gojo's right hand completes its rise to face height and forms the sign, middle finger crossed over the index. One hand, as in canon (logged deviation from the brief's 'hands together'). f6-26: GOJO: "Domain Expansion." Quiet and flat. Beyond the sign, Thragg has finished trimming his flight, and his eyes go to the hand. He has never seen this: no orbs, no charge, no pull, just a gesture. f26-32: a half-beat. Thragg's read is Seq 5's lesson: when this man needs time, strike before the thing forms. f32-50: "Unlimited Void." f36-52: Thragg coils: his weight drops, his right hand draws back into a spear-hand, the stump of the left arm tucks, the cape shreds lift. f52: one compressed anticipation frame. f53: his drive fires, the first frame of the lunge, body pitched forward. f53-56: the sign holds perfectly still. In this instant Gojo has fixed the domain's length: about two seconds, double Shoko's ~1 s for Sukuna. It becomes visible on the objective clock in S6-13.
shots.animatic_caption: Silence. One hand, middle finger over index: "Domain Expansion. Unlimited Void." Thragg lunges.
shots.prompt_core: Low over-the-shoulder shot from behind a tall white-haired man hovering above a ruined street at dusk. In the sharp left foreground his raised right hand forms a precise sign at face height, middle finger crossed over the index finger, silhouetted against the sky with a warm rim of sunset light on the knuckles. Eight metres beyond, sharp in the right background, a massive one-armed man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit hangs low in the air above a crater, eyes fixed on the hand, coiling: his weight drops, his right hand draws back into a spear-hand, and shredded crimson cape remnants lift. Fine dust drifts slowly through the air. Smoke columns and torn storm clouds rise behind him.

tactical.intent: Gojo: a sure-hit, the one thing this body cannot dodge, pre-set to two seconds.
tactical.read: Thragg: no orbs, no charge, only a gesture. The man needed time for his last big technique, so strike before this one forms.
tactical.outcome: Thragg's drive fires on the last syllable, and the barrier closes on the first frame of his lunge, 8 m out.
tactical.learned: Thragg: nothing yet. It lands before he can learn.

shots.animation_notes: Gojo is a held silhouette except for the hand forming the sign (f0-6, on 1s, precise) and one breath in his shoulders. No lip-sync is visible in the OTS. Thragg on 2s for the read and on 1s for the coil, with one compressed anticipation frame at f52 before the drive. Dialogue pace is about 9 frames per word, with a 6-frame pause between the two phrases. The score is fully ducked: the voice is the only sound.

shots.action: PERCEPTION TIME begins at f0. From here to the end of the sequence about 2.0 s of real time plays as about 20 s of screen, roughly 9.5:1. The domain floods experienced time, and Gojo's Six Eyes perception is canonically accelerated (G2-16). It is not slow motion. This shot covers real 0.00-0.28 s. f0: the snap: a tiny bead of absolute black appears at the crossed fingertips. f0-7: total silence; nothing moves. f8-24: the black sphere erupts from the sign outward, its edge a razor-thin line of cold blue light. It swallows the hand, the street, the dusk and Thragg's lunging silhouette (screen-right, wiped mid-launch), then overtakes the lens. f24-30: pure black. f30-36: stars ignite at impossible depth, then concentric rings receding to a vanishing point, a slow galactic spiral, and streams of luminous information rushing outward past the camera, far too fast to read. f34-64: the camera pulls back and back to two tiny figures in the void: Gojo screen-left, Thragg screen-right, frozen on the first frame of his lunge. The sure-hit has taken him, and his lunge's momentum has died with his mind.
shots.animatic_caption: A black sphere swallows the frame from the sign outward. Inside: a boundless void of light and information.
shots.prompt_core: A hand with the middle finger crossed over the index; a bead of absolute black blooms at the fingertips and erupts outward as a perfect black sphere edged with a razor-thin line of cold blue light. It swallows the hand, the dusk street and the silhouette of a lunging giant. Then darkness, and stars igniting at impossible depth: concentric rings of pale light receding to a vanishing point, a slow galactic spiral, and dense streams of luminous particles rushing outward past the viewer. The view pulls far back to two tiny figures suspended in the boundless void: a slim white-haired man on the left and a massive one-armed man frozen mid-lunge on the right. Deep blacks, cold blue-white light, no floor, no horizon.

shots.action: Perception time: real 0.47-0.68 s. f0-20: his eyes, unblinking. The pupils are flooding: thin streaks of light pour into them from every direction, more than an eye could hold. A muscle under one eye has begun a twitch that never completes. One brow is half-lifted, a nostril half-flared, the snarl half-formed: micro-expressions frozen midway. f20-28: rack focus forward to a single speck of asphalt dust between him and Gojo, kicked up by his plant and falling with him. f28-46: the speck unfolds, and in its facets its whole history streams past, unreadably fast: the street being poured, decades of tyres, Thragg's landing crater cracking open, the violet light of Purple. Then every speck in frame does the same, and the frame saturates with information. This is what he is being made to perceive, all of it, at once, and he cannot process any of it.

shots.animation_notes: The Blue follows the VFX bible's grammar exactly: a clear focal point; light objects first (dust, then blood droplets, then cape shreds) on straight-line streaks; no swirl. Output is kept low, a pin rather than a crushing pull, so the body hangs from it instead of flying into it. Thragg's turn is a rigid-body rotation driven by the pull, since the overload gives no muscle response: his head turns with the torso and his eyes stay fixed. Gojo glides on 2s with an elegant, economical body line; his feet find no floor. This Blue stays up as the pin until the domain ends (it is the ledger's Blue x1).

shots.action: Perception time: real 0.91-1.20 s. Gojo knows the rule (G1-32): touch exempts, so every touch is one frame. f0-3: wind-up. f4: contact one: Gojo's left palm snaps Thragg's cocked right elbow up and out of the line; for that single frame the streaks pouring into Thragg's pupils freeze, then pour on. f5-8: wind-up. f9: contact two: two fingers snap his hip square, putting the heart behind the open ribs; strobe. f10-13: wind-up. f14: contact three: a fingertip finds the gap between two exposed ribs, the target; strobe. f15-22: anticipation: Gojo draws his right hand back, fingers locked into a spear-hand, shoulder and hip winding. f23: CONTACT: the spear-hand drives into the flayed ribs toward the heart (impact frame). The contact lasts, so Thragg is exempt for its whole duration. f24-28: the streaks stop pouring in, but what has already arrived stays: his pupils, still clouded and unequal, drag onto Gojo's eyes, murderous. f26-38: his body acts before he could think. The whole torso corkscrews around Gojo's arm against the Blue's hold, the reflex that took him out of Purple's core, and the ribcage rolls a hand's breadth along the fingers. The heart slides off the line. f32: two ribs snap. f35: the fingers punch into the left lung instead. f38-44: frothy blood bursts from his mouth. f44-66: Gojo is in to the wrist and has missed the heart. Thragg's eyes have not left his, and Thragg's right hand begins to rise.
shots.animatic_caption: Three one-frame touches each pause the flood for a frame. The spear-hand for the heart lasts longer: Thragg's body wakes.
shots.prompt_core: Tight two-shot in profile inside a starry void. On the left, a white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform drives a rigid spear-hand, fingers locked together, wrist-deep into the raw, flayed ribs of a massive one-armed man on the right. The streaks of light pouring into the giant's eyes have stopped, but his pupils are still clouded with them, and through that haze they lock on his attacker's with murderous focus. His whole torso corkscrews around the attacker's arm, ribs cracking, frothy blood bursting from his mustached mouth. A small white-blue sphere glows behind his right shoulder. Cold blue-white light, streams of luminous particles rushing past, a burst of blood droplets hanging in the air.

tactical.intent: Gojo: kill while he is frozen: the heart, by hand, through the open flank, as he did to Sukuna. Keep every other touch to one frame so the exemption never gives Thragg time.
tactical.read: The three strobes confirm that contact wakes him, and a spear-hand cannot last only one frame.
tactical.outcome: Exempt for the length of the thrust, Thragg's body slips the heart off the line. Ribs break and the left lung ruptures; the heart is missed.
tactical.learned: Gojo: touching him wakes him, and the Six Eyes cannot tell him what his hand just hit.

shots.animation_notes: The three contacts are single-frame snaps on 1s, each with 4 frames of wind-up, and each strobe is exactly one frame of frozen inflow (the streaks pour on again on the next frame); the clouding never clears. The spear-hand has 8 frames of anticipation and its contact frame at f23, with an impact-frame treatment (fr.invert on f23 only) and 2 frames of 6 px shake. Thragg's corkscrew is the first self-willed motion since the domain closed: big, fast, on 1s, driven from the hips and twisting against the Blue's hold. His strength is plain, and it buys him a lung instead of his heart. Gojo's arm stays straight and locked, and the twist does not turn him.

shots.action: Perception time: real 1.20-1.42 s. Thragg is still exempt (still touched). f0-2: his right hand comes up and around, fingers hooked for the windpipe, and covers 80% of the gap. f3: the deceleration begins; 15% more over f3-9, then it crawls. f10-22: it hangs 1 cm from Gojo's throat: fingers straining, blood from the knuckles beading in the air, a thin ripple of compressed air ahead of the fingertips. No flash and no surface: Infinity is up, because Limitless runs inside the domain. His strength is plain in the trembling forearm, and useless. Gojo does not look at the hand; he holds Thragg's eyes. f22-28: Gojo withdraws the spear-hand in one clean pull, leaving an arc of blood beads frozen in the air behind it. f28: contact ends, and the flood slams back. In a single frame Thragg's pupils fill with light-streaks again, his snarl freezes half-formed, and the hand stops trying. f28-50: Gojo drifts back a metre. The frozen hand stays where it was, reaching for a throat that is no longer there.

shots.action: Perception time: real 1.42-1.95 s. f0-40: the uninterrupted flood. Blood stands in frozen beads at his nostrils, ears and tear ducts. f20-30: his pupils go unequal, the left blown wide and the right a pinpoint, and blank: the light-streaks keep pouring in, and nothing looks back out. An irregular heartbeat thuds. His right hand still hangs, reaching for nothing. f40-50: rack focus to Gojo in the background, breathing hard, chest heaving, narrowed eyes on Thragg. f50-90: he cannot tell whether this is killing him: the Six Eyes show the faint haze, not the heart or the brain behind it (R5). He glances at his own blood-wet right hand, the hand that woke Thragg, and flexes it. f90-104: he looks back at Thragg, and his jaw sets. Decided: no more touching in here. He will finish by hand outside, where a body that has taken two seconds of this should stay frozen. f96-120: he drifts back to his corner, out of reach and squared to Thragg, and lets the pre-set run out. f100-110: focus racks back to Thragg's bleeding, blank face. Focus returns to a face now streaked with blood from nose, ears and eyes: it ran while out of focus, never on screen.

shots.prompt_core: Close-up of a massive man's face frozen in a starry void, three-quarter view on the right: close-cropped black hair, black mustache, a torn left ear. Blood runs from his nose, thin threads of blood trickle from his ears, and blood tears spill from the corners of his eyes. His pupils are unequal, one blown wide and one a pinpoint, both blank and flooded with streaks of pale light; frothy blood sits at his lips. Softly behind him on the left, a white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform hovers, breathing hard, blue eyes narrowed and bloodshot, looking down at his own blood-wet right hand, then back at the giant. tactical.read: The Six Eyes cannot read Thragg's vitals: the flood might be killing him, or might not. Every touch inside wakes him. Outside, two seconds of flood (ten times Shibuya's dose) should leave him frozen.

tactical.learned: Gojo: a precise blow can be slipped, so the finish must not depend on finding the heart. Seq 7's internal Red pays this off.

shots.action: OBJECTIVE REAL TIME, an overlapping cutaway. f0 is the instant the barrier closed, the same instant as S6-06 f0. f0-47 is real 0.00-2.00 s: everything shown inside, from S6-06 to S6-12, happened within these two seconds, inside this silent shape. A perfect black dome sits over the west corner of the intersection: no reflection, no texture, no sound, only a hair-thin line of cold blue light where it meets the asphalt. Wind tugs dust and loose paper across the street and around its curve. Smoke drifts from the eastern towers; light shafts fall through the torn cloud deck; far left, the lit city glows, untouched. f48: the pre-set expires at exactly 2.0 s. f48-60: the dome thins from its crown downward, its black turning smoky and translucent with the dusk beginning to show through; the blue base line flickers. Cut before anything inside can be seen.
shots.animatic_caption: Outside, in real time: a silent black dome sat over the corner for exactly two seconds. It begins to thin.
shots.prompt_core: Wide low shot of a ruined dusk intersection seen from street level. Over the left corner sits a perfect hemisphere of absolute black, about thirteen metres high, with no reflection or texture and only a hair-thin line of cold blue light where it meets the asphalt. Wind drives dust and loose paper across the empty street and around its curve. To the right, a clean channel is cut through dark towers, its violet afterglow faded, smoke columns rising; shafts of warm evening light fall through torn storm clouds. Far left, across a river, a lit city glows under a smouldering sunset. At the end, the black dome thins from its crown downward, turning smoky and translucent.
shots.animation_notes: The dome is a flat, perfect black shape with zero shading; it reads as a hole in the picture. Only the base line carries light. Everything around it moves at real speed: dust on 1s, paper on 2s, smoke slow. The f48-60 thinning is a top-down dissolve to 60% opacity that never reveals the figures; Seq 7 owns that reveal.

shots.action: Perception time ramping back to real time: real 2.00-2.50 s, the flood ebbing from about 7:1 down to near 1:1 by the cut. f0-20: inside, the information streams slow and dim, and the rings stop receding. f12-60: the void dissolves from its edges inward. The starfield peels back from the frame's borders like burning film, and through the gaps comes the real dusk: warm light from screen-left, the torn street, the sheared mast pole behind Gojo. f30-60: the Blue behind Thragg's shoulder gutters and shrinks; the technique is about to burn out. f60-84: real light floods in through the last ragged gaps of the void and falls on both. Gojo hovers 3 m up at his corner, breathing hard, narrowed eyes on Thragg, weight forward, blood-wet hand loose at his side. Thragg hangs 8 m east, frozen mid-lunge, bleeding from nose, ears and eyes, his frozen right hand reaching for nothing, the Blue a dying pinpoint at his shoulder. f85: the reversed shatter: the last of the void collapses and, on the same frame, the Blue's pinpoint winks out. Burnout begins on the cut. The consequences of the exchange are one frame from being revealed.
shots.animatic_caption: The void peels back from the edges. Dusk light returns. Both hang in the air, about to drop.
shots.prompt_core: Wide level shot of two figures hanging in the air above a ruined dusk street as a starry black void peels away from the edges of the frame like burning film, letting in warm evening light from the left. Left, a tall white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform hovers three metres up beside a bent, armless traffic-light pole, breathing hard, blue eyes narrowed, right hand bloodied to the wrist. Right, eight metres away, a massive one-armed man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit hangs frozen mid-lunge, his flank flayed, blood running from his nose, ears and eyes, his right hand reaching for empty air; a tiny dying white-blue spark glows at his shoulder. Dust hangs in the light.
shots.animation_notes: The dissolve is edge-inward, organic and asymmetric (never a clean iris). The returning world is the city exactly as it was left (env.STATE[6]), lit by the film's dusk rim from screen-left. Both fighters are held, breathing only: Gojo's chest heaves; Thragg does not move. The Blue gutters on 1s, shrinking to a pinpoint by f84; it winks out on f85, the same frame as the reversed shatter. The last frame must match Seq 7's first frame exactly: x=-7, y=3 and x=+1, y=2.
